invariants.rationale: The method returns a list, so it should not be null at method exit.
All SmallFile objects in result should have size smaller than the configured small file limit.
Each SmallFile in result should have a valid location with non-null commit time and file ID.
partitionPath is a parameter and should not be null, thus all SmallFiles are related to a valid partitionPath.
The return type is List<SmallFile>, so result should be an instance of List.
